name: Premium Rectangle Flags
descriptionHtml:
Make a strong visual impact with our Premium Rectangle Flags, designed for maximum branding space and clear messaging at trade shows, outdoor events, storefronts, festivals, and vendor booths. The rectangular shape provides a clean, bold layout that keeps your logo and message highly readable from a distance.

Available in 6.5ft, 10ft, and 14.5ft sizes, all rectangle flags are double-sided by default, ensuring your branding is visible from both directions. Your artwork is printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation on premium knitted polyester fabric for vibrant, fade-resistant results.

Each flag comes standard with a cross base and water bag, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments. For additional flexibility, you may upgrade to ground stakes or a canopy mounting kit, allowing the flag to be securely mounted directly to a canopy tent.

Constructed with strong yet flexible fiberglass poles, these flags are lightweight, durable, and easy to assemble—ideal for vendors who need reliable, professional signage.

🔹 Key Features

🚩 Rectangle Flag Design – Large print area for bold, clear branding
📏 Available Sizes – 6.5ft, 10ft, and 14.5ft
🔁 Double-Sided Printing Included – Standard on all flags
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Sharp, fade-resistant graphics
💪 Fiberglass Poles – Lightweight, flexible, and durable
⚓ Base Included – Cross base + water bag included
🏕️ Multiple Mounting Options – Optional ground stakes or canopy mounting kit
🧳 Portable & Easy Setup – Perfect for events and promotions

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation

🔹 Materials

🧵 Graphic / Flag: Knitted Polyester
🦾 Hardware: 100% Epoxy Fiberglass
🎒 Carry Case: 600 Denier Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, outdoor events, vendor booths, canopy tents, storefront advertising, festivals, promotions, and brand activations.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
